newsitem.title: INDIA: India call trades to be routed via primary dealers.
newsitem.headline: India call trades to be routed via primary dealers.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Tuesday said call money transactions can be routed through all primary dealers.

"It has been decided to extend the facility of routing call money transactions to entities through all the primary dealers with effect from the fortnight beginning April 26, 1997," RBI said in its credit policy statement for the first six months of 1997/98 (April-March).
RBI said the minimum size of operation per transaction would be reduced to 100 million rupees from the current 200 million.
